description: Fork of exp606 (vanilla MinimalGPT + LUT FFN, NAP=6 tph=1024). SINGLE change: lut_input_nap 6 -> 4 (K=64 -> 16). Atoms/layer 65K -> 16K (4x less). Params 150.99M -> 37.7M FFN (-113M). Bandwidth UNCHANGED at 12.58 Mbits/layer (NAP doesn't affect inference BW). Per-row gradient coverage 128 -> 512 tok/row/step at bs=16 — matches the exp390/exp593 winning regime where K=16 had enough rows to be well-covered by bs=16. Total params ~54M, trunk 189 Mbits, total 591 Mbits. Reference: vanilla exp328 (1.3882, 23.2M, 339 Mbits trunk). exp607 hits at 2.3x params for slightly better expected quality than exp606 at much lower per-row coverage.
